data.description:
Move GET-rotation stamps into `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json` so a later rollout step can remove them from the large sort-ordered `bindings.json`. A2-1 is the compatibility half: new binaries write both formats and read `max(new, legacy)`; A2-2 removes the legacy write after its observable rollout gate. session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** contains the measured facts.

## Why

`set_last_get` stamps `last_get_pass` on up to `deletion_probe_limit` (default 20) bound-but-absent keys per pass. Measured: exactly 20 entries change per affected pass. The full A2 saving is realized only after A2-2 removes this scattered legacy write. During A2-1, dual-write is intentional compatibility cost: an old binary cannot read the sidecar, so it must still observe progress made by new binaries.

## Approach — compatibility first

Write every new stamp to the sidecar and the legacy inline field, and read the chronological `max(sidecar, legacy)`. Under mixed versions an old binary may advance only the inline field; `max()` ensures a following new binary does not use stale sidecar state. Conversely, dual-write ensures an old binary following a new one sees the new progress. Values are fixed-width zero-padded timestamps, so lexicographic `max()` is chronological.

Load legacy-only rotation state in memory and persist the sidecar only through `BindingStore.save()`. This covers all production save paths: end-of-pass persistence, the write-ahead saves in `dispatch_one.py`, and the recovery/retirement saves in `binding_store.py`. Saving unchanged canonical state must remain byte-stable. `reconcile-check` runs with `persist=False`, never reaches save, and must not create the sidecar.

Add `git_adapter.GET_ROTATION_FILE`, characterize its path, and include it in both `reconcile_helpers.py` explicit staging and basename membership checks. This is required because local reconciliation does not use `git add -A`. The existing `.gitattributes` glob covers the new file. Update the `_store/push.py` docstring that enumerates regenerable files.

`outbound_differ.py` is at the locked 800-line cap. Move the existing last-GET and best-effort bookkeeping wrappers across the new rotation seam so the module remains at or below the cap.

## Rollback

Reverting A2-1 is safe: a reverted reader ignores the sidecar but every new-binary pass also advanced the inline legacy field. The orphaned sidecar is inert.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [code-verifiable] After rotation state is initialized, an idempotent real-repo pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD. Tier: integration in a real temporary git repository.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A pass with at most 20 absent-key GETs advances identical selected-key stamps in `get_rotation.json` and the legacy inline fields. Tier: integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The explicit local commit path stages and commits both changed rotation files without `git add -A`. Tier: real-git integration.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Rotation order after an interleaved old-binary/new-binary pass sequence matches the all-new sequence. Tier: integration; it must fail for either sidecar-first lookup or missing dual-write.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A legacy inline-only store yields identical rotation order. Tier: unit.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] A legacy inline-only store materializes equivalent sidecar state on its next persisted save. Tier: unit.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `rebar reconcile-check` against a pre-migration store leaves `git status --porcelain` empty. Tier: CLI subprocess.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `rebar reconcile-check` against a pre-migration store does not create `get_rotation.json`. Tier: CLI subprocess.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `git_adapter.GET_ROTATION_FILE` names `.bridge_state/get_rotation.json`. Tier: git-adapter characterization.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The `_store/push.py` regenerable-files documentation includes `get_rotation.json`. Tier: characterization test.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `outbound_differ.py` remains at or below 800 lines. Verify with the repository module-size gate.

## Files

`binding_store.py`, new `get_rotation.py`, `outbound_differ.py`, `git_adapter.py`, `reconcile_helpers.py`, `_store/push.py` (docstring), focused tests.

Scope: M. Depends on closed A1.
